newsitem.title: CHINA: Erdos Cashmere seen beating net target.
newsitem.headline: Erdos Cashmere seen beating net target.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products Co Ltd expects to surpass its 1996 profit target of 181 million yuan, which is eight million yuan higher than its 1995 net profit, a company official said on Thursday.

The official cited strong domestic sales and a gradual increase in export prices as well as a 60 percent expansion of the company's sales outlets in the second half of 1996 as reasons for its success.
He said he was optimistic about Erdos' prospects for 1997, saying orders were strong, and that overseas prices could rise further. He gave no forecast details.

Erdos, the world's largest producer of cashmere, listed 110 million B shares on the Shanghai stock exchange in October 1995. Its 1995 net profit was 173 million yuan and its 1996 interim profit was 67 million yuan.
The official said the company wanted to issue an additional 100 million B shares by March 1997, and was awaiting approval from shareholders and the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
